rules.title: Rules of the Game
rules.deadlineIntro: Every match must be played within <1>two (2) weeks</1> of the round starting. If a match has not been played when the deadline passes, the game is awarded <2>3–0</2> to the participant who is ready and willing to play. If neither participant is willing to play, the match is decided by the tournament admin.
rules.objectiveText: Each tournament is played as <1>round robin</1> followed by <2>playoffs</2>. The goal is to finish with the most points after all round-robin matches, then win through the playoffs to become the tournament champion.
rules.structure1: An admin creates the tournament and sets a player-facing password.
rules.structure2: Players are added to the tournament before it starts.
rules.structure3: Round-robin matches are generated in <1>rounds</1> — each player plays exactly one match per round, facing every other player once.
rules.structure4: After all round-robin matches are complete, the <1>top 8 players</1> in the standings advance to the playoffs.
rules.matchText: Every match is played as <1>best of five (first to 3) frames</1>. The player who wins a frame scores a point for that frame, and the player who reaches 3 frames wins the match.
rules.matchText2: Results are recorded frame by frame. Individual frames can be corrected or removed if a mistake was made when entering the result.
rules.scoring2: Winning the match (first to 3 frames) = <1>1 additional point</1>.
rules.scoring3: So a 3–2 match win earns <1>4 points</1> (3 frames + 1 match win).
rules.scoringText: Standings are ranked by <1>total points</1>, then frames won, then matches won.
rules.playing1: Only matches in the <1>current round</1> can be started.
rules.playing2: Both participants agree on a time and play within the <1>two-week deadline</1>.
rules.playing3: The winner of the match (or a trusted participant) enters the frame results.
rules.playing4: Once every match in a round is complete, the next round opens.
rules.playoffs1: If the tournament was split into divisions, the top 2 of each division advance directly to the playoffs and the 3rd/4th of each division play cross-division qualifiers, as described below. Otherwise the top 8 players advance.
rules.playoffs2: Quarter finals (no divisions): first vs last (1st vs 8th) and 4th vs 5th; the rest pair as 2nd vs 7th and 3rd vs 6th.
rules.playoffs3: The winner of 1st vs 8th plays the winner of 4th vs 5th, and the winner of 2nd vs 7th plays the winner of 3rd vs 6th. The two semi-final winners meet in the final.
rules.division1: An admin may randomly split the tournament into two divisions, Division A and Division B. Players play only against their own division in the round robin. If the player count is odd, one division has one player more.
rules.division2: The split is previewed and can be adjusted — players can be moved between the divisions — before it is saved.
rules.division3: Playoffs: the <0>top 2 of each division advance directly</0>. The 3rd of Division A plays the 4th of Division B, and the 4th of Division A plays the 3rd of Division B; both winners qualify. Final is played cross-division.
